item: the places and Wikidata status line follows a language change
summary: entitySpineResolve and entitySpineFetch share #es-status; both now set it through _esStatus(render, title), which keeps a render function evaluated in the current language. The host is data-i18n-dyn and esStatusRepaint from the oo:langchange listener redraws it without a request. Both lines leave the frozen-renderer list (296).
